name: tag
description: FR-BB21 (roadmap section 2.1) -- ports the tags table from c:\Users\tvolo\dev\ai-dala\BilimBaga\backend\migrations\008_categories_tags.up.sql. name is :string, queried: true, required: true, and constraints declares one entry (uq_tag_name, type "unique", fields ["name"]) matching the source's name TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL -- REQ-298's constraint_def compiles to a real unique index, so this is expressible exactly. name is deliberately :string rather than :localized_text: a tag is an authoring-side vocabulary token, the source carries no translation table for it, and roadmap 2.1 exposes tags through an autocomplete rather than as candidate-facing content. This is the one place in this pack that diverges from the "user-visible text is localized" pattern applied everywhere else (category.name, question.stem, question.explanation, answer_option.text). No id, created_at, updated_at or created_by field is declared: the record subsystem mints record identity and the event store carries the audit timeline, so declaring these here would duplicate platform-owned state inside tenant content.
